description: Get canonical brand voice for the site. Pass domain or site_id to target a specific site; omit to use the auth default. Always pass the same domain/site_id used with patch_brand_voice so both tools operate on the same record. Also returns pronoun_mode and approved_facts when set, empty otherwise — the account-aware check_brand_voice guidance.

domain.description: Site domain to scope this call to (e.g. example.com). Alternative to site_id.

site_id.description: Site UUID to scope this call to. Alternative to domain.

name: get_brand_voice
title: Get Brand Voice
